title: QuillBot Pricing 2026: Is Premium Worth Paying For?
summary: QuillBot pricing ranges from free to $19.95 monthly for Premium. Understand what features come with each tier to decide if paid plans justify the cost.
body_markdown:
## Where Activepieces Fits a Paraphrasing Workflow


Only a team that repeats the same rewrite, summarise or check on drafts arriving from several places gets anything from Activepieces, an MIT-licensed workflow automation tool with 747 integrations; it doesn't replace QuillBot or lower what you pay for it.


If you never address the repetition, you pay in hours. Someone copies a draft out of an email, pastes it into a rewriting tool, copies the result back, and does it again for the next one.


Every handoff is a chance to paste into the wrong file or skip a draft altogether.


### When a workflow beats a subscription


You build a chain of steps in Activepieces that runs on its own, and the free plan allows unlimited flows with 1,000 credits a month.


A trigger starts it, such as a new Google Doc draft, an email landing in a shared inbox, or a message posted in a Slack channel.


Next, the text goes to an AI model with instructions you wrote once: tighten this, summarise it in three sentences, flag anything that reads as copied. The result goes back where the team already works.


Nobody carries drafts by hand any more; that's the point. The illustration below shows the route: three sources feed one workflow, the AI step rewrites, and a reviewed draft returns to the Doc with a person checking it before anything is final.


` {{ILLUSTRATION}}`


Take from it that the person stays in the loop; the automation does the carrying and the first pass, not the sign-off.


### When a workflow isn't worth building


For one person editing now and then, building a workflow costs more effort than it saves. You'd spend your time setting up triggers and testing instructions to avoid a few minutes of pasting.


It also doesn't touch the problem this article is about. If you keep hitting QuillBot's free-plan limits on long text, a workflow doesn't lift them, and the AI step brings its own usage terms from whichever model you connect.


Decide on QuillBot Premium by how much text you process and for how long. Consider Activepieces only after that, if the handling around the text is what's eating your week; MoneyGram, Moneypenny, Alan and FundingSocieties already run it.
